scope: Synthetic public example track; no historical outcome replay or real data.
plant: Read-only source vehicle_dynamics_st, source constraints, RK4 dt=.002s. Perfect plant state available to every controller.

architecture.pure_pursuit: Source PP lookahead1.2, speed profile gain1.2; source pid/steering relay maps target angle/speed to physical rate/acceleration at100Hz.
architecture.lqr: Standalone scheduled Frenet full-state feedback on direct steering-rate/acceleration with steady-turn feedforward and common PP startup below2m/s.
architecture.mpc: Standalone constrained linear MPC on corrected scheduled Frenet model;15 steps, exact ZOH, state/input bounds, shifted feasible warm start; common PP startup below2m/s.

interface_difference: Historical F110 wrapper applies relay/PID every2ms and a steering-target buffer. New study maps PP at100Hz and applies the same4ms physical input delay to all controllers; it does not reproduce the wrapper.

model_schedule.linearization: Finite-difference Jacobian of full nonlinear Frenet plant at a consistent steady-turn trim; exact ZOH.
model_schedule.curvature_stencil: Geometric central6-segment span, about1.2m; fixed before outcomes.

completion: One unwrapped geometric progress circuit >=156.3586m, rather than historical toggle>=4 episode.
collision: Actual oriented0.58x0.31m rectangle versus occupied map pixel cells by separating-axis test; same test for all controllers. No source LiDAR TTC.
approved_change: Parent authorized rectangular geometry correction after offline proof that the prior circumscribed-circle screen stopped PP without rectangular body contact. v1protocol/results remain preserved.

acceptance_before_pilot.state_bound_tolerance: Source clamp allows one integration-step overshoot: sv_max*DT and a_max*DT.
acceptance_before_pilot.optimizer: Stop on first solver failure or >1e-6 predicted-constraint violation; no tuning/retry.
acceptance_before_pilot.case_completion: Report rectangle contact/timeout as valid negative pilot outcomes and continue the comparison. Only numerical/input/optimizer gate failures stop it.
acceptance_before_pilot.timing: Retain every full controller-call time, including model cache miss, p50,p95,max and count>10ms. Timing alone is not hard-real-time qualification.

authorization: Parent explicitly approved20paired scenarios/controller nominal plus6prespecified OATcells after the three rectangular-footprint sanity pilots.
controller_tuning: No controller retuning. Frozen rectangular pilot laws,Q,R,horizon,trim,grid and constraints.
pairing: Each cell uses identical20scenario draws; same realization across controllers. Controller order per seed/cell is a deterministic PCG64 permutation.
uncertainty: Paired differences and paired bootstrap intervals over scenario seeds. Completion proportions include failures; lap-time intervals are conditional on common completions and report that denominator.
mass_limitation: m and yawI scale together. In this normalized-tire model m/I stays fixed and mass cancels elsewhere; expected structural null, not physical mass-robustness evidence.
physical_domain: Perfect state; normalized linear-tire F110 dynamics; no battery, sensor, tire saturation or real-car validation. Record slip and lateral-acceleration/mu*g proxies. Exceedance is a model-validity warning, not silently excluded data.
timing_scope: Full controller-call wall times on a shared Windows host. Other CPU work may run concurrently. No hard-real-time hardware claim.

local_integration_gate.scenario: Independent fixed-control RK4 source-plant straight-to-turn transient2s at3m/s, steer .05rad, rate .03rad/s, accel .3m/s2.
local_integration_gate.scope: Local source-integrator sanity; not a whole-trajectory global error bound.
